desc: While incense is burning in this censer, you can use an action to speak the censer's command word and summon an @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.banHjKDMCegbUwYE]{Air Elemental}, as if you had cast the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.1LkZvINag7KqBmDR]{Conjure Elemental} spell. The censer can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
This 6-inch-wide, 1-foot-high vessel resembles a chalice with a decorated lid. It weighs 1 pound.
name: censer of controlling air elementals
